name: DevelopingPolaroidRow
job: Show photos as instant prints that slowly develop from milky blank to full colour as they scroll in, then straighten when hovered
visitor_action: scroll or swipe to develop; hover or focus a print to straighten it; click, tap, Enter or Space enlarges it, Escape sets it down
mobile: horizontal swipe row of 2 visible prints; tap enlarges
motion: image fades from milky blur to sharp with eased saturation ramp, staggered per print, tilt springs flat on hover (reduced-motion: fully developed, static tilt)

checks.render: pass (1 fix: develop waits for image load, default speed 4s to 3.2s)

art_direction: Instant film: cream plastic borders, faded cyan-green developing haze, handwritten blue-ink captions, soft table shadow
